openclaw-vps.why: Ruling (Krish, 2026-09-20), delegated: this clock stops being a liveness beat. R4 retires the VPS as orchestrator and R7 declared openclaw-vps a permanent surface, and the two never agreed. A host that is on purpose winding down cannot also be a thing that must beat hourly, and a clock that can never beat again turns the dashboard red forever, which is how a person learns to ignore a red dashboard. Its token has been rejected since 2026-09-19T09:05Z and rotating it was declined on 2026-09-20, so it will not beat again. The surface stays declared, and what is watched inverts: not "did it beat" but "is it still writing anything a surface reads". The retirement map is the ledger of that, and this marker is removed only when the host is off.
